label: Spinning Globe
author: community
description: Animated Earth globe with latitude/longitude grid and simplified continents. Choose holographic wireframe or classroom solid style, set axial tilt, and spin speed (deg/sec). Fully procedural — no image assets required.

properties.label: Style
properties.help: Holographic: cyan wire grid + glow. Classroom: filled oceans/land with soft shading.

lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
local opacity = {opacity}
local style = '{style}'
local tilt = math.rad({tilt_deg})
local spin = math.rad({spin_speed}) * wall_clock()
local ar, ag, ab = {color}
local or_, og, ob = {ocean_color}
local show_grid = {show_grid}
local show_land = {show_continents}

-- Sphere fill (classroom) or soft disc (holographic)
if style == 'classroom' then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, or_, og, ob, opacity * 0.95)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  -- soft limb darkening
  local _g = cairo_pattern_create_radial(cx - R * 0.25, cy - R * 0.25, R * 0.1, cx, cy, R)
  cairo_pattern_add_color_stop_rgba(_g, 0, or_ * 1.15, og * 1.15, ob * 1.1, opacity * 0.35)
  cairo_pattern_add_color_stop_rgba(_g, 1, 0, 0, 0, opacity * 0.55)
  cairo_set_source(cr, _g)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_pattern_destroy(_g)
else
  -- holographic outer glow
  for i = 3, 1, -1 do
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.06 / i))
    cairo_set_line_width(cr, i * 2.2)
    cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R + i * 1.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar * 0.15, ag * 0.25, ab * 0.35, opacity * 0.25)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
end

-- Project lon/lat (degrees) → screen after spin + tilt; returns sx,sy,visible
local function project(lon_d, lat_d)
  local lon = math.rad(lon_d) + spin
  local lat = math.rad(lat_d)
  local x = math.cos(lat) * math.sin(lon)
  local y = math.sin(lat)
  local z = math.cos(lat) * math.cos(lon)
  x, y, z = _globe_rot_x(x, y, z, tilt)
  if z < -0.02 then return nil end
  local sx = cx + x * R
  local sy = cy - y * R
  return sx, sy, z
end

if show_land then
  for _, p in ipairs(_GLOBE_LAND) do
    local sx, sy, z = project(p[1], p[2])
    if sx then
      local pr = R * 0.055 * p[3] * (0.55 + 0.45 * z)
      if style == 'classroom' then
        cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.55 + 0.4 * z))
      else
        cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * (0.35 + 0.5 * z))
      end
      cairo_arc(cr, sx, sy, pr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
      cairo_fill(cr)
    end
  end
end

if show_grid then
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, style == 'holographic' and 1.1 or 0.8)
  -- meridians
  for m = 0, 11 do
    local lon0 = m * 30
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lat = -85, 85, 4 do
      local sx, sy, z = project(lon0, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    if style == 'holographic' then
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.45)
    else
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.22)
    end
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
  -- parallels
  for lat = -60, 60, 30 do
    cairo_new_path(cr)
    local started = false
    for lon = 0, 360, 4 do
      local sx, sy, z = project(lon, lat)
      if sx then
        if not started then cairo_move_to(cr, sx, sy); started = true
        else cairo_line_to(cr, sx, sy) end
      else
        started = false
      end
    end
    if style == 'holographic' then
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.4)
    else
      cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, opacity * 0.18)
    end
    cairo_stroke(cr)
  end
end

-- limb / outline
cairo_set_line_width(cr, style == 'holographic' and 1.6 or 1.2)
if style == 'holographic' then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.85)
else
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar * 0.5, ag * 0.5, ab * 0.5, opacity * 0.5)
end
cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
cairo_stroke(cr)

-- holographic scanline shimmer
if style == 'holographic' then
  local t = wall_clock()
  local band = (math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * R * 1.6 - R * 0.3
  cairo_save(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R - 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_clip(cr)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, ar, ag, ab, opacity * 0.12)
  cairo_rectangle(cr, cx - R, cy - R + band, R * 2, 6)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  cairo_restore(cr)
end
